text:
alex: Quick heads-up — since the kernel-selection tweak last night we're seeing odd memory growth on long-context tests. Repro on cb-longctx: steady increase in RSS during 32k seqs. Anyone else?

maria: saw it. Perf suite showed KV cache fragmentation rising with cont-batch merges. Might be reuse logic failing when `merge_threshold` hits.

jun: grabbed a flamegraph — top hits in kv_slot_reclaim and contbatch_merge_lock. attaching snippet.

perf-bot: perf-runner finished: cb-longctx-32k: 3 runs mean RSS growth +220MB/run; p99 latency +12%. link: http://perf/reports/2092345678

alex: paste flamegraph lines:
```
kv_cache::allocate_slot
kv_cache::try_reuse
contbatch::merge_batches
kernel::select_optimal
```

maria: that ordering suggests head-of-line blocking during merge keeps slots pinned; remap code path in try_reuse returns false sometimes.

jun: repro script:
```
./bench --scenario=cb-longctx --seq=32k --workers=8 --merge-threshold=4
```

alex: runs with `--merge-threshold=1` look fine. So merge logic is suspect.

maria: I added logging around slot_refcount; finding cases where refcount increments but never decremented when merge aborts. probably branch on split path.

jun: can confirm. saw logs:
```
[kv] slot=0x7f9b refcount=2 hold=1 origin=cont-merge abort=true
```

olivia: might be interaction with kernel selection optimistic path — if select_optimal returns quantized kernel, we take fast path that skips decrement in fallback case.

alex: @olivia good catch. Can someone run a build with guard on kernel path and see if decrement happens?

maria: running a debug build now, will run perf job in ~15m.

jun: quick mitigation — set merge_threshold to 0 for staging to avoid merges; reduces RSS growth but increases p99 slightly. patch posted: D1234.

alex: noted. Also want a unit test to simulate merge abort and assert slot refcount zero. Assign to @jun?

jun: I'll add test in kv_cache_tests::merge_abort_refcount.

perf-bot: CI perf baseline queued D1234.

maria: follow-up: debug run shows decrement missing in `merge_split_cleanup` when `contbatch->head_locked == true`. PR incoming.

alex: ok next steps: (1) temporary config rollback in staging (done) (2) hotfix to ensure decrement in split cleanup (maria) (3) unit test (jun) (4) perf run to validate (perf-bot). Thanks :thumbsup: 

olivia: also worth auditing kernel selection fast path for other resource accounting holes. filing ticket #INF-412.

alex: leaving logs and flamegraphs in the thread artifact folder: s3://redwood-perf/artifacts/2092345678 — ping if you need access.

maria: I'll post PR when tests pass, linking to perf job.

jun: working on test now, ETA tomorrow morning.

alex: great work — short rollback and test should keep staging stable.
